lilly_meaning: Conjunctions are good or bad, as the Planets in conjunction are friends or enemies to one another
source: Lilly, Christian Astrology (1647), ch. XIX pp.105-106

lilly_meaning: The Sextill and Trine aspects are arguments of Love, Unity and Friendship
source: Lilly, Christian Astrology (1647), ch. XIX pp.105-106

lilly_meaning: the Quadrate Aspect is a signe of imperfect enmity
source: Lilly, Christian Astrology (1647), ch. XIX pp.105-106

lilly_meaning: the Trine is more forcible (than the sextile)
source: Lilly, Christian Astrology (1647), ch. XIX pp.105-106

lilly_meaning: the Opposition is an aspect or argument of perfect hatred
source: Lilly, Christian Astrology (1647), ch. XIX pp.105-106
